724:t_2:24.en:
$$赤木$$
「It's hopeless...! We... can't protect the city... or the peace!」

724:t_2:25.en:
$$ロジャー$$
「My memories... are slipping away...」

724:t_2:27.en:
$$宗介$$
「Don't go, $$千鳥$$...! You're not $$ソフィア$$. You're $$千鳥かなめ$$!」

724:t_2:31.en:
$$シンジ$$
「$$綾波$$...! I... wanted to save you!!」

724:t_3:4.en:
$$スメラギ$$
「...Then this dimensional barrier system can seal $$アサキム$$ away?」

724:t_3:5.en:
$$テッサ$$
「It extracts $$次元力|lc$$ like $$ＺＯＮＥ$$, then diverts it into another dimension... With this, surely...」

724:t_3:6.en:
$$トライア$$
「Honestly, I'm not confident. But this is the best we can do right now.」

724:t_3:7.en:
$$スメラギ$$
「Hearing that is enough. All that remains is to try it.」

724:t_3:8.en:
$$ブライト$$
「Our remaining time is limited. We must hurry as much as we can.」

724:t_3:9.en:
$$ジェフリー$$
「$$アサキム・ドーウィン$$ and the $$御使い$$s... They possess the power of immortality...」

724:t_3:10.en:
$$Ｆ．Ｓ．$$
「So our coming showdown with $$アサキム$$ will be a test for our battle against the $$御使い$$s...」

724:t_3:12.en:
$$ブライト$$
「It means we must win.」

724:t_3:13.en:
$$トライア$$
「I'll finish the final adjustments here. I'm counting on you all to devise the operation to stop $$アサキム$$ from moving.」

724:t_3:15.en:
$$テッサ$$
「Then, Doctor... $c will descend to $$エス・テラン$$ in twelve hours.」

724:t_3:16.en:
$$トライア$$
「...We've done everything we can... Now we leave the rest to fate.」

724:t_3:17.en:
$$トライア$$
(But I'm completely at a loss over the other problem...)

724:t_3:18.en:
$$トライア$$
(Distortions in the dimensional boundaries throughout the universe are spreading faster and faster... What on earth is causing them...?)

724:t_3:19.en:
$$トライア$$
(What does the universe want...? How do the $$御使い$$s intend to stop it...?)

724:t_10:4.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「I understand how you must feel, $$グーラ$$.」

724:t_10:5.en:
$$グーラ$$
「At the last moment, Father, who had become the $$宇宙魔王#pilot$$, returned to being the father I remembered...」

724:t_10:6.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「Had he managed that sooner, things might have turned out differently.」

724:t_10:7.en:
$$グーラ$$
「It's all right... I'm sure Father would never have acknowledged the power of hope unless he had been defeated.」

724:t_10:8.en:
$$グーラ$$
「I... will live with pride in having helped Father regain his old heart at the very end.」

724:t_10:9.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「Your firm resolve has produced 100 Z worth of $$Ｚチップ$$s, $$グーラ$$. I shall add them to the team's stock.」

724:t_10:10.en:
$$グーラ$$
「So these are the $$Ｚチップ$$s born from my battle with Father... They're beautiful.」

724:t_10:12.en:
$$グーラ$$
「I will live with strength, so I never disgrace this light. That is the final hope Father left behind.」

724:t_10:13.en:
$$グーラ$$
(Goodbye, Father... I... will live alongside $$正太郎$$ and the others, with hope in my heart...)

724:t_10:20.en:
$$メール$$
「He's been lost in thought for a while now. I think it must be about $$アサキム$$.」

724:t_10:21.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「Is he thinking about how to beat the stuffing out of him?」

724:t_10:22.en:
$$メール$$
「No. I think Darling wants to talk to $$アサキム$$.」

724:t_10:23.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「He wants to talk to that vile, ruthless monster?!」

724:t_10:24.en:
$$メール$$
「I do think what $$アサキム$$ did to $$セツコ$$ is unforgivable.」

724:t_10:25.en:
$$メール$$
「But Darling just... can't seem to bring himself to hate him.」

724:t_10:26.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「Hmm... It is true that during the $$多元戦争$$, $$ランド$$ and $$アサキム$$ sometimes understood one another...」

724:t_10:27.en:
$$メール$$
「That's why I think Darling doesn't want to fight $$アサキム$$.」

724:t_10:30.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「$$アサキム$$ has his own way of life... I shall simply let events take their course.」

724:t_10:31.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「Then let us conduct business quietly at $$Ｄトレーダー$$ today, so we do not disturb $$ランド$$.」

724:t_10:33.en:
$$メール$$
(Darling... Whatever answer you reach, I'll follow you...)

725:t_000:0.en:
$$ロージェノム$$
「I confirm that the hyperspace transfer succeeded.」

725:t_001:0.en:
$$リーロン$$
「There's no doubt. It's the third planet of the solar system in the Milky Way of the $$カオス・コスモス$$...」

725:t_001:1.en:
$$シモン$$
「So it's this universe's Earth... $$エス・テラン$$.」

725:t_001:2.en:
$$トライア$$
「Incidentally, we call it a solar system, but there doesn't seem to be a sun as we know it in our world.」

725:t_001:3.en:
$$エスター$$
「Then the light around here comes from $$エス・テラン$$.」

725:t_001:4.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「And that dimensional barrier around it... It reeks of self-display, as if they were proclaiming how special they are.」

725:t_001:5.en:
$$リーロン$$
「This isn't the time for that. It looks like our welcoming party is already coming.」

725:t_001:6.en:
$$ダヤッカ$$
「Combat is highly likely! We're launching too!」

725:t_002:0.en:
$$竜馬$$
「I don't care if it's $$アサキム$$ or the $$御使い$$s. Either way, we'll take them on.」

725:t_003:0.en:
$$甲児$$
「$$ハーデス$$! And $$ズール$$ and the $$宇宙魔王#pilot$$!」

725:t_003:1.en:
$$ワッ太$$
「You finally showed yourselves, ringleaders of the $$邪神連合$$!」

725:t_003:2.en:
$$ズール$$
「You surprise me, Earthlings. I never imagined you had survived.」

725:t_003:3.en:
$$ハーデス$$
「And your arrival at this planet is nothing short of a miracle.」

725:t_003:4.en:
$$赤木$$
「Too bad for you. We did this with our own strength.」

725:t_003:5.en:
$$ノリコ$$
「We make miracles happen through our own power.」

725:t_003:6.en:
$$ハーデス$$
「Hmph... Your arrogance is insufferable.」

725:t_003:7.en:
$$正太郎$$
「Are you after the $$御使い$$s on that planet too?!」

725:t_003:8.en:
$$宇宙魔王#pilot$$
「Indeed. That will bring the battle of the gods... the True War, to its end.」

725:t_003:9.en:
$$ハーデス$$
「We reached this place by defeating the many gods who crossed the $$天柱$$ and invaded this universe.」

725:t_003:10.en:
$$ズール$$
「We did so to overthrow the $$御使い$$s and claim everything in this universe.」

725:t_003:11.en:
$$勝平$$
「For you guys, I'm impressed you managed that without fighting each other!」
